name: Nemo Stats: Weapons GL
description:
Tunes the grenade launchers' projectile damage and spread.

Tighter spread and reduced sway. Consistent damage/blast radius between GL-21, GP-31, GL-15.
GL-28 fires bolter rounds from a 400-round backpack.

- GL-21 Grenade Launcher
  Tighter spread, damage match evictor.
- GL-52 De-Escalator
  Two rounds per reload, bigger damage.
- GL-28 Belt-Fed Grenade Launcher
  Fires bolter rounds, bigger capacity.
- GL-15 Evictor
  Tighter spread.
- GP-31 Grenade Pistol
  Tighter spread.
